headline: La Negrilla House / Croxatto y Opazo Arquitectos
context: La Negrilla House is a vacation home located in Matanzas , Chile, approximately two and a half hours south of Santiago. Situated 164 feet (50 meters) above sea level, the house overlooks the Pacific Ocean and the surrounding coastal landscape.
